_comment: English message catalogue. Every key must also exist in tr.json; tests/unit/test_i18n.py asserts parity. Placeholders are named.
anchor.line: [WIZRELAY] Active task {task_id} · research v{version} · role {role} · scope mode {enforcement} · open questions {questions}
audit.clean: No violations. {count} changed path(s) are all accounted for.
audit.heading: ## Scope audit — {task_id} ({role})
audit.integrity_unlocked: present but not recorded in the lock
audit.skipped_no_init: This repository is not connected to a hub, so no scope check was performed.
audit.skipped_no_task: No task package matched {reference}, so the audit was skipped.
brief.commands: Project commands from the repository profile:
brief.no_active_task: No task package is active. Run /wizrelay:pull <reference> to load one.
brief.no_init: This repository is not connected to a research hub. Run /wizrelay:init to connect it.
brief.phase: Routing for the {phase} phase: {model} at {effort} effort.
comment.deep_link: Or open a session directly (paste into your browser's address bar):
context.no_active_task: No task package is active in this repository.
context.open_questions: {count} question(s) are still open in questions.md.
context.protocol: The working rules are in .wizrelay/PROTOCOL.md, imported through CLAUDE.md.
context.routing: Routing: {tier}, score {score}. Implementation runs on {model} at {effort} effort.
context.scope_missing: The package defines no scope for role {role}.
context.truncated: [context truncated at {limit} characters; run /wizrelay:status for the full picture]
doctor.errors: {count} error(s). Scope protection may be inactive until these are fixed.
doctor.warnings: {count} warning(s). Nothing is broken, but review the lines marked !.
err.hub_unavailable: The research hub could not be reached.
err.hub_unavailable_why: No hub is configured, or the clone failed.
err.no_active_task_why: Neither .wizrelay/.active-task nor the branch name identifies a package.
err.no_roles: No roles were given and the hub defines none.
err.no_roles_fix: Pass --roles backend,frontend, or set `roles` in wizrelay-hub.json.
err.no_roles_why: A package needs at least one role so scope and acceptance criteria can be assigned.
err.not_a_repo: This directory is not inside a git repository.
err.not_a_repo_fix: Run `git init`, or change to a directory inside your repository.
err.not_a_repo_why: wizrelay anchors scope globs and deny rules at the repository root.
err.not_hub: This command only runs inside a research hub.
err.not_hub_fix: Run `wizrelay hub init` here, or change to the hub repository.
err.not_hub_why: There is no wizrelay-hub.json at the repository root.
err.not_initialised: This repository is not connected to a research hub.
err.not_initialised_fix: Run `wizrelay init --role <role> --hub <url>`, or /wizrelay:init in Claude Code.
err.not_initialised_why: There is no .wizrelay/config.json in this repository or any parent.
err.not_published: {task_id} has status {status}, so it cannot be pulled.
err.not_published_fix: Ask the researcher to publish it, or pass --allow-draft to accept a draft.
err.not_published_why: Only published packages reach developer repositories (invariant I8).
err.package_exists: A package directory named {folder} already exists.
err.package_exists_fix: Pass --force to reuse it, or remove tasks/{folder} first.
err.publish_blocked: {folder} has {count} validation error(s) and cannot be published.
err.publish_blocked_fix: Run `wizrelay hub validate {folder}` and fix every error listed.
err.task_invalid: task.json in {folder} does not match the task schema.
err.task_invalid_fix: Ask the researcher to run /wizrelay:hub-validate and publish again.
guard.causes: Likely causes: another installed plugin uses the manifest name `wizrelay`, hooks are disabled (disableAllHooks), or this folder was not trusted. Run /wizrelay:doctor.
guard.inactive: Scope protection is not active in this session.
hook.ask_no_scope: The package {task_id} defines no scope for role {role}, so this edit cannot be checked.
hook.ask_out_of_scope: {file} is outside the scope of {task_id}. In scope: {allow}.
hook.deny_out_of_scope: {file} is outside the scope of {task_id}. In scope: {allow}. Raise a question with /wizrelay:ask rather than widening the scope locally.
hook.deny_researcher: {file} belongs to the researcher and is read-only here ({task_id}). Ask through /wizrelay:ask; the answer arrives as a new package version.
hook.deny_scope: {file} is explicitly denied by the scope of {task_id} (pattern {pattern}).
hook.pre_edit_error: wizrelay could not evaluate this edit against the task scope, so it is asking instead of deciding.
hook.switch_below_tier: {to_model} is weaker than {wanted}, which this task was routed to.
hook.switch_downgrade: Switching from {from_model} to {to_model} drops to a weaker model.
hub.empty: This hub has no task packages yet.
hub.protocol: The researcher protocol is in this hub's CLAUDE.md.
hubinit.next: Next: fill in wizrelay-hub.json, commit, then run /wizrelay:hub-new <reference>.
hubnew.next: Next: fill in the package, then run /wizrelay:hub-validate {task_id}.
init.mcp_manual: {tracker}: the MCP endpoint was not written automatically. {note}
init.next_steps: Next: fill in the placeholder values in .wizrelay/config.json and .wizrelay/profile.json, then run `wizrelay doctor`.
migrate.next: Next: run `wizrelay doctor`, then commit the result.
migrate.nothing: Nothing to migrate: no .ai/ directory was found.
publish.next: Next: commit tasks/{folder}, push, then post the comment from `wizrelay hub comment {task_id}`.
pull.changes: Since the last pull: {added} added, {modified} changed, {removed} removed.
pull.removed: Removed, no longer in the hub: {files}
pull.scope_missing: This package defines no scope for role {role}.
pull.skipped_developer: Kept your own copy of {file}; the hub's version was not copied.
status.no_active_task: No task package is active. Run /wizrelay:pull <reference>.
status.not_initialised: This repository is not connected to a research hub. Run /wizrelay:init to connect it.
stop.header: wizrelay: this turn changed files outside the scope of {task_id}.
stop.integrity_changed: - {file} is a researcher file and no longer matches the published version.
stop.integrity_missing: - {file} is a researcher file and is missing.
stop.next: Revert what should not have changed, or raise it with /wizrelay:ask. /wizrelay:verify reports this too.
sync.next_changes: decisions.md changed. Re-read it, then update plan.md and close any question it answers.
sync.next_no_changes: Carry on; there is nothing to reconcile.
sync.next_review: Review the changes above against plan.md before continuing.
sync.no_changes: {task_id} is already at v{version}; nothing changed in the hub.
sync.restored: Restored from the hub (they had been modified locally): {files}
validate.warnings: ### Warnings ({count}) — these do not block publication
warn.integrity: The pulled package no longer matches what was published: {changed} changed, {missing} missing, {unlocked} unrecorded. Run /wizrelay:sync.
warn.model_below_tier:
This session's model is weaker than this task was routed to. Consider restarting with:
  {launch}
warn.stale_version: {task_id}: you have v{locked}, the hub has v{current}. Run /wizrelay:sync before continuing.
